                    function updateClock() {
                        const now = new Date();
                        document.getElementById('clock').innerText = now.toLocaleTimeString('id-ID');
                    }
                    setInterval(updateClock, 1000);
                    updateClock();

                    // Web Audio Speech Calling
                    let lastCalledId = null;
                    function speakCall(queueNum, deptName) {
                        if ('speechSynthesis' in window) {
                            const text = `Nomor antrean ${queueNum}, silakan menuju ${deptName}`;
                            const utterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
                            utterance.lang = 'id-ID';
                            utterance.rate = 0.9;
                            window.speechSynthesis.speak(utterance);
                        }
                    }

                    // Auto refresh polling every 6 seconds
                    setInterval(function() {
                        fetch('/health/queue/api/live', {
                            method: 'POST',
                            headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                            body: JSON.stringify({params: {}})
                        }).then(r => r.json()).then(data => {
                            if (data.result && data.result.calling && data.result.calling.length > 0) {
                                const latest = data.result.calling[0];
                                if (latest.id !== lastCalledId) {
                                    lastCalledId = latest.id;
                                    speakCall(latest.queue_number, latest.department_name);
                                }
                            }
                        }).catch(e => console.log('Poll err', e));
                    }, 6000);
